name: alicankorkmaz-marketplace
description: Learning skills for coding agents: fast-learning (speed to functional competence by a deadline) and road-to-mastery (depth-first mentorship to expertise), shipped as one plugin.

plugins.name: learning
plugins.description: Two learning skills: fast-learning (do one concrete thing by a deadline: placement test, 20% syllabus, retrieval checks, spaced-retrieval queue, graded explain-backs) and road-to-mastery (mentorship to expertise: mission, diagnosis, adaptive challenges with multi-approach expert feedback, elite mental models, spaced recall).
